text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe. Looking good!
Just a little bit more and it's complete!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As Sweep Tosho grinned mischievously, the dorm head, Fuji Kiseki, came over to check on her.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Oh? I wondered what you were up to, but it's rare to see you making sweets, Sweep.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I can make sweets too, you know!
Chocolates, just like you're supposed to for Valentine's!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'll feed this to my familiars
and make them obey my every command!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
A Valentine's magazine feature...
'Enchanting Magic Chocolate Recipes,' huh.
Fufu, this looks like it'll work wonders!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ah, they're almost done baking!
Behold, Sweepy's special "Baked Chocolates"!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, it stiiiinks!?
What is this smell!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hmm...
By the way, what did you put in it?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"I only put completely normal ingredients in it!
Just like the book said: chocolate, powdered sugar, and..."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
To boost its effects, I boiled down mugwort and dokudami...
plus some wild mulberry and multiflora rose, and added them in!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I see, it's imbued with highly concentrated magical energy!
...But I wonder if your familiar can withstand it?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: !! Right... Even if you're my familiar, your magical power is below average after all!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like, why don't we remake it?
I'd be happy to help!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yep, ingredients and measurements are all good!
So far, right on recipe—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"‘Next, bake thoroughly in the oven,’ it says!
Hmph, are you underestimating me!?
I can do it in a flash with a single spell!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Scorch all of creation!
Salvia☆Splendens... turning up the heat!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... that's consuming a ton of mana!
Let me adjust it just a bit
so you don't run out of energy!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Now all that's left is wrapping it up! I'll bind it tightly with magical rope so none of the mana escapes...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Oh? According to the spellbook, it says "Tie a cute ribbon gently to make them swoon."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
It's true! The magic of captivation
is surprisingly profound...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While hard at work in the trainer's office,
a cheerful Sweep Tosho came to visit.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Familiar... Happy Valentine's Day!
Take this special baked chocolate!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I see... Today is Valentine's Day.
I was so caught up in work that it completely slipped my mind.
choice_data_list: Thank you, that makes me happy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I opened the box, the aroma of baked chocolate
filled the room. It looks delicious!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
These are special chocolates I made just for you!
I'm sure once you eat them—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
(I'm sure... before you know it, you'll be completely captivated by me!
And then, you'll――)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
(You're gonna obey my every word
and become even more like a proper familiar!)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
—Fufu! It's bound to be addictive!
Plus, I had Fuji-san help tone down the magical potency, so it's just right for you!
choice_data_list: So this chocolate is from the two of you.
So this chocolate is from both of you.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Right, from both of—wait, what?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
(Wait a second...! Does that mean the magic of
two people went into this chocolate?
Which means—)

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Now then, my familiar. I expect you
to work very hard for my sake.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you can't really bring yourself to defy me, can you?
After all, you are completely enchanted by me—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: —You can't do that!!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You're my familiar, aren't you?!
Hurry up and give that chocolate back!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: My chocolate was snatched away in the blink of an eye!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
No "hows" or "whys" about it!
No means no!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho's handmade chocolates
vanished into the great beyond...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: —You can't do that!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The moment it enters your mouth... crispy on the outside, crumbly on the inside.
It's baked chocolate that rivals a pastry shop!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Ahhh! Why are you eating that--?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Stupid, stupid, stupid, stupid!!
The magic's gonna take effect, you know!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Just asking, but you wouldn't run errands even if Fuji-san asked, right!?
choice_data_list: If you're having trouble, maybe I can help?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Nggghhh!!
You're my familiar, what do you think you're saying?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Now we have no choice but to perform a curse-breaking ritual!
Lie down on that sofa over there!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems best not to disobey right now...
I lie down on the sofa as told.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Eps Medium, Eps Medium! Return this soul unto the Lord! Immediately!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Alright! How's that?
Did you remember who your true master is, me or Fuji-san!?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Phew... You really are a handful! Listen,
if you ever pick up and eat food off the
ground again, you'll be in big trouble!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though her expression was clumsy, it seems she truly cares about me in her own way.
This Valentine's Day made that crystal clear!
